amoCRM_behavior.production_dates_push: Correctly logs 'skipped: amoCRM credentials not configured' when credentials not set. When configured, sends note via add_note_to_amocrm and updates custom fields via syncBackFields.
amoCRM_behavior.sync_from_amocrm: Returns 400 'amoCRM не настроен' when credentials not configured. When configured, updates existing leads with stage changes (action='synced_from_amocrm'), totalAmount (price), clientName, modelName, phone, manager.
